name: STOP
meaning: Come to a complete stop before proceeding when safe.

name: YIELD
meaning: Slow and yield to traffic or pedestrians who have the right-of-way.

name: DO NOT ENTER
meaning: Do not enter the roadway from this direction.

name: Speed Limit 25
meaning: The posted speed limit is 25 mph where the sign applies.

name: Speed Limit 55
meaning: The posted speed limit is 55 mph where the sign applies.

name: No Parking
meaning: Parking is prohibited where the sign applies.
memory_tip: Read nearby time or zone restrictions.

name: Warning
meaning: Alerts you to a road condition or hazard ahead.

name: Right Turn Only
meaning: Traffic in the lane must follow the indicated direction.

name: Information
meaning: Provides route, service, or road information.
